Name: Better Shopping SVE
Author: QueenQuackin
Description:
[size=4]Better Shopping has now expanded in to Stardew Valley Expanded! [/size]

This mod does require you to have Stardew Valley Expanded and its requirements installed to function properly. This mod is also not dependent on my other Better Shopping mods.

Items Included so far will be listed in the Articles Section along with another article explaining how to obtain the items that don't have a crafting or cooking recipe.

Currently this only affects Vanilla Shops I do plan to update it down the line to include SVE Shops.

This mod allows you to set the Price, Available Stock, to enable Items or not and you get to pick if you want to use conditions or not.

If you have any issues please report them to the bugs section that way I will be notified as soon as I get on Nexus and I do not always check the comments on all of my mods.

If you are submitting a bug report please make sure you have your smapi log attached. To obtain your parsed SMAPI log go to https://smapi.io/log follow the onsite instructions for parsing your log. After you have done that add the resulting link to your report. Also please be as detailed as possible about the problem that you are currently having.

Happy Shopping!!

Big thanks to FlashShifter for creating SVE
